summary: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Ltd (NASDAQ: BAOS) filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, announcing a press release correction regarding its entry into a strategic acquisition memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Blue Intelligence Cloud Innovation Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. The company proposes to acquire a 40% equity interest in the target, an AI marketing technology firm, to enhance its capabilities in AI-driven marketing, content generation, and user analytics. The target will retain independent operations, with existing shareholders holding the remaining 60%. No financial terms, price, or premium were disclosed. The MOU is non-binding; a definitive agreement and closing conditions remain to be seen.
